== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Urzaia Woodsman{{!}}Urzaia's black hatchets are a pair of dark, [[Awakened weapons]] used by the [[Izyrian gladiator]] and cook [[Urzaia Woodsman]]. Crafted by an [[Izyrian]] master smith, these hatchets are believed to possess a unique [[Intent]] and may serve as the user's [[Vessel]]. The blades are described as appearing dull in certain lighting, as if they absorb light, and they are capable of striking with immense force, such as shattering missiles or driving [[giant]] creatures into [[stone]]. In combat, the hatchets are used with great speed and precision, capable of splitting enemies in half or being hurled with sudden intensity. They are essential tools for the Urzaia Woodsman{{!}}Woodsman, who often carries them in both hands to face various threats.}}
